title: War of the Golden Stool
summary: The English Wikipedia article "War of the Golden Stool", at revision 1377091714, opens: "The War of the Golden Stool, also known as the Yaa Asantewaa War, the Third Ashanti Expedition, the Ashanti Uprising, or variations thereof, was a campaign in 1900 during the series of conflicts between the United Kingdom and the Ashanti Empire, an autonomous state in West Africa that fractiously co-existed with the British and its vassal coastal tribes." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q356920, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "final war of the Anglo-Ashanti wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
